applications-powertoys.description: Current-user settings for PowerToys and its packaged applications.

command_palette.description: Settings owned by the packaged Microsoft Command Palette application.

activation_shortcut.description: Global shortcut that opens Command Palette.

grab_and_move.description: Settings for the PowerToys Grab And Move utility.

activation_modifier.description: Modifier key held while moving or resizing a window.

enabled.description: Whether Grab And Move is enabled for the current user.

applications-powertoys.title: PowerToys configuration

default_profile.description: Profile selector using guid:<guid>, name:<name>, or source:<dynamic-profile-source>. It must resolve to exactly one profile.

disabled_profile_sources.description: Dynamic profile generators disabled through Terminal's disabledProfileSources setting.

graphics_api.description: Graphics API used by Terminal's renderer. Automatic removes the explicit rendering.graphicsAPI override.

key_bindings.description: The complete desired set of Winix-owned actions and their key combinations. When key_bindings is present, Winix removes omitted actions whose IDs use the Winix. prefix; configured keys also replace any existing binding for the same key combination.

overrides.description: Profile changes keyed by guid:<guid>, name:<name>, or source:<dynamic-profile-source>. Source selectors may update multiple generated profiles.

tab_switcher_mode.description: Ordering and UI behavior used by nextTab and prevTab actions.

state.description: Desired package state. The first implementation supports removal only.

appx.description: AppX/MSIX packages managed for the selected user.

propertyNames.description: Exact, case-sensitive AppX package Name (not PackageFullName or display name).

appx.title: Current-user AppX packages

arp.description: System programs removed by stable uninstall-registry identity.
arp.title: Add/Remove Programs registrations

state.description: Requires the extension to be installed and enabled. Omitted extensions are unmanaged.

extensions.description: Microsoft Edge Add-ons that Edge must install and keep enabled by machine policy.

state.description: Desired font family state. Omission means installed.

nerd-fonts.description: Nerd Font families installed from official ryanoasis/nerd-fonts release archives.

propertyNames.description: Exact, case-sensitive Nerd Fonts release asset name, without the .zip suffix (for example JetBrainsMono, FiraCode, or Hack).

nerd-fonts.title: Nerd Fonts

prerelease.description: Allow prerelease versions when resolving the requested version. Omission uses stable releases only when resolution is requested.

state.description: Desired installation state. Omission means installed.

version.description: An exact version or 'latest'. Omit to accept any installed version.

propertyNames.description: Exact, case-sensitive PowerShell Gallery module name.

windows-desktop.description: Controls desktop icon visibility and the solid desktop background color.

color.description: Solid desktop background color as a six-digit RGB hex value.

icons.description: Whether all desktop icons, including files and shortcuts, are shown.

windows-desktop.title: Desktop personalization

developer_mode.description: Allow development and sideloading without a developer license.

long_paths.description: Enable Win32 long path support for applications that opt in.

windows-installer.description: Machine-wide MSI products identified by canonical product code.

propertyNames.description: Uppercase MSI product code including braces.

windows-installer.title: Windows Installer products

alt_tab.description: Controls whether Alt+Tab shows application windows or individual tabs from supported applications.

provider.description: The Windows servicing catalog that owns this exact resource name.

state.description: Whether the capability or feature is enabled. Disabling a classic feature retains its payload.

windows-optional-features.description: Desired state for Windows capabilities and classic optional features. Feature keys are exact native names. Capability keys may be exact native names or omit the tilde-delimited qualifier and version suffix when the remaining name uniquely identifies one catalog entry. Localized display names are not supported.
windows-optional-features.title: Windows optional features

windows-power.description: Desired consumer display and presence-aware timeouts for the active Windows 11 power scheme. Values are seconds; zero disables the corresponding timeout.

presence_sensing.description: Windows 11 human-presence timeouts. These settings have an effect only on devices with a compatible presence sensor and when the consumer Presence Sensing feature is enabled.

away_dim_after.description: Time after the sensor reports that the user has left before Windows dims the display.

away_display_off_after.description: Lock on Leave delay: time after the sensor reports that the user has left before Windows turns off the display and begins the lock experience.

inattentive_dim_after.description: Time after the sensor reports that the user is looking away before Windows dims the display.

inattentive_display_off_after.description: Time after the sensor reports that the user is looking away before Windows turns off the display.

windows-power.title: Windows 11 power and presence settings

windows-remote-desktop.description: Controls whether Remote Desktop connections are accepted. This mirrors the WindowsDeveloperConfig registry setting and does not manage firewall rules or Windows edition support.
windows-remote-desktop.title: Remote Desktop host setting

windows-screen-saver.description: Controls whether the current user's screen saver is enabled. Disabling it is equivalent to selecting (None) in the Windows Screen Saver Settings dialog.

state.description: Whether screen saving is enabled. The selected screen saver, timeout, and sign-in behavior remain unmanaged.

windows-screen-saver.title: Screen saver

folders.description: Folders displayed beside the power button on Windows 11.

oem_pins.description: Desired state of the placement's OEM LayoutModification.json. System placement manages the Default user template; user placement manages the current profile.

shortcuts.description: Start Menu shortcuts managed relative to the placement's Programs directory. System placement uses the all-users Start Menu; user placement uses the current user's Start Menu.

propertyNames.description: Relative .lnk path beneath the Start Menu Programs directory.

show_recent_items.description: Show recently opened items in Start, Jump Lists, and File Explorer.

show_recommendations.description: Show recommendations in the Windows 11 Start menu.

slots.description: The ordered taskbar apps. An exhaustive list maps deterministically to Win+1 through Win+5.

app.description: A portable Winix application alias resolved on the target machine.

exhaustive.description: When true, remove pins not listed in apps and make these the Win+number slots. When false, retain other pins, which may precede these apps.

other_icons.description: Maps live notification-area display names to whether their icons appear directly on the taskbar or in the hidden-icon overflow menu.

windows-update.description: Controls supported Windows Update preferences available on current Windows 11 editions. These preferences do not disable servicing or guarantee that Windows will never restart.

get_latest_updates_as_soon_as_available.description: Receive optional updates and gradual feature rollouts as soon as they are available for the device.

restart_notifications.description: Notify the interactive user when an installed update requires a restart.

update_other_microsoft_products.description: Receive updates for other Microsoft products alongside Windows updates.

windows-update.title: Windows Update preferences

windows-wsl.description: WSL and distributions offered by the WSL online catalog.

distros.description: Exact distribution names from `wsl.exe --list --online` to ensure are installed. Omission manages no distributions, and other installed distributions are left unchanged.

first_run_oobe.description: Suppress the current user's Windows 'Welcome to WSL' first-run experience. This does not skip a distribution's own account setup.

preview.description: When upgrading, select the latest WSL prerelease instead of the latest stable release. Omission uses the stable channel when version is managed.

state.description: Desired WSL installation state. Omission means installed. Setting absent also unregisters every installed distribution and deletes its data.

version.description: Set to latest to upgrade WSL. Omit to accept the installed WSL version.

windows-wsl.title: Windows Subsystem for Linux

state.description: Desired installation state. Omission means installed.

version.description: An exact version or 'latest'. Omit to accept any installed version.

winget.description: Packages managed through Windows Package Manager.

propertyNames.description: Exact, case-sensitive canonical WinGet package ID.

winget.title: WinGet packages

devices.description: Device-specific overlays keyed by Windows computer name.
